name: @w6w-apps/printavo
description: Manage customers, contacts, quotes, invoices, tasks, inquiries and payments in Printavo, the print-shop management system, via its GraphQL API v2.

w6w.longDescription: Printavo is shop-management software for screen printers, embroiderers and promotional-product shops: customers and contacts, quotes that become invoices, production statuses, tasks, inquiries and payments. This app covers that core over Printavo's GraphQL API v2 (`POST https://www.printavo.com/api/v2`, authenticated with your Printavo email and API token): list, read, create, update and delete customers, contacts, quotes, invoices and tasks; move a quote or invoice to a new status; record payments; read inquiries, payment requests and the product catalog.
